0022600136.text: The Raptors (2-1) host the Magic (1-2) in Toronto for their fourth game of the season, with Toronto third in the Atlantic at 0.5 games back and fifth in the East, while Orlando sits 10th in the East and 1.5 games back in the Southeast. Toronto is without Brandon Ingram (Achilles, surgery), Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation; 19.5 points and 25.8 minutes per game this season, after 27.9 and 32.1 last season), and Nate Bittle (foot fracture), while Orlando is missing Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Raptors won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 139-87 win over Orlando in Toronto on March 29, 2026.
